_meta.title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus — lab template
_meta.author: Shadman Bari
_meta.purpose: Reference shape for recreating an Intune Endpoint security Antivirus profile or Settings Catalog entries. Not an exported Intune policy. No tenant identifiers.
_meta.recreate_in: Intune admin center → Endpoint security → Antivirus → Create Policy → Microsoft Defender Antivirus
_meta.safety: Lab / trial only. Pilot before broad assignment.

settings.name: AllowRealtimeMonitoring
settings.rationale: On-access scanning for deskside malware stop-loss

settings.name: AllowCloudProtection
settings.rationale: Cloud-delivered / MAPS lookups for emerging threats

settings.name: CloudBlockLevel
settings.rationale: Lab starting point; raise after false-positive review

settings.name: PUAProtection
settings.rationale: Cuts adware/toolbar tickets; use Audit first if software inventory is messy

settings.name: AllowIOAVProtection
settings.rationale: Scan downloaded files and attachments where supported

settings.name: SubmitSamplesConsent
settings.rationale: Improves cloud protection; avoid SendAllSamples on tightly regulated labs without review

assignment.note: Assign only to a lab pilot Entra group. Do not embed real group object IDs in this file.
